text:
alyssa_marketing: Quick thread — finalizing X / LinkedIn cadence for the webinar + benchmark narrative. Need a few items by EOD Tue: hero image (1200x675), 3 X copy variants, 2 LI long copies, RSVP link + UTM, and inbound routing plan. Live: Wed 09:00 PT. Can folks drop assets + routing here?

diego_growth: UTM draft is here: ?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch&utm_medium=x. I'll add to the shared doc. For inbound routing: thinking mentions -> Intercom inbox tag 'webinar-benchmark' and then zap -> SFDC for hot replies.

tori_design: Uploading hero + 3 carousel frames to Figma now. One design note — lighten text on slide 3 so it reads on mobile. Will post link when done. :paintbrush:

alyssa_marketing: Awesome — @tori_design please paste the Figma link here when ready. Also we need A/B messaging: "benchmark-results" angle vs "cost-savings" angle. Which do we lean into for paid promo?

sean_analytics: +1 on A/B. Recommend split 60/40 (benchmark/story vs cost). I'll add param variant=bench or variant=cost to UTMs and wire into dashboard.

maria_cs: For routing — we can add Intercom rules to tag and route. Need a list of trigger phrases for auto-tagging and what qualifies as "hot." Suggest triggers: pricing, demo, SLA, enterprise, POC.

diego_growth: I'll prototype a simple filter for the zap. Example rule I'll use in the zap builder: 
```
if tag == 'webinar-benchmark' and text_matches(/demo|pricing|SLA/i):
  create_lead_in_sfdc()
```
What should we treat as hot vs warm?

maria_cs: Hot = explicit asks for demo/pricing or company email on RSVP. Warm = questions about content, asking for slides. Hot route to CS queue, warm to nurture drip.

alyssa_marketing: Draft X copy options (short):
1) "New benchmark: speed vs cost for open models. Join our webinar Wed — register 🔗"
2) "How teams cut inference cost by 3x — live panel & benchmarks. RSVP →"
3) "Want predictable LLM latency? See the numbers we ran. Free webinar."
(we'll A/B test these)

tori_design: LinkedIn long copy + alt hero (16:9) in Figma notes. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/benchmark-launch — will update images now.

publish_bot: Scheduled preview created for Wed 09:00 PT on X and LinkedIn. Preview: https://publish.example/preview/123 — check visuals + copy.

alyssa_marketing: Perfect. Final ask: everyone confirm assets + routing by EOD Tue. If you have blockers, say now. Thx :pray:

diego_growth: Confirmed — UTMs, zap filters, and the basic SFDC mapping are ready. I'll monitor on send.

tori_design: Done — uploaded final hero + carousel. Fixed mobile contrast on slide 3.

maria_cs: Routing rules drafted and will deploy tonight (Intercom + notify CS Slack channel).

sean_analytics: A/B tracking wired to dashboard. Cohorts named: bench / cost. I'll post dashboard link after we QA the UTMs.

publish_bot: Posts queued. Will post at scheduled time and report deliverability / impressions after publish. :rocket:
